name: Wan 2.1 VACE 1.3B
summary: Versatile lightweight model supporting text-to-video, reference-to-video, and video-to-video. Same size as the base 1.3B with more capabilities.

name: Wan 2.1 T2V 1.3B
summary: Smallest video generation model. Generates short 2-second clips from text prompts. Fast enough for desktop, potentially viable on high-end phones.

name: Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B
summary: Mid-range text+image-to-video model. Good balance of quality and speed at 5B parameters. Uses Wan 2.2 VAE for improved decoding.

name: Wan 2.1 T2V 14B
summary: High-quality text-to-video generation. Produces detailed, coherent 2-4 second clips with strong prompt adherence. Desktop only — needs significant memory.

name: Wan 2.1 VACE 14B
summary: High-quality versatile model supporting text-to-video, reference-to-video, and video-to-video. More capable than the base 14B T2V model.

name: Wan 2.1 I2V 14B 480P
summary: Image-to-video model — animates a still image into a short video clip at 480p. Requires a CLIP vision encoder for image understanding.

name: Wan 2.1 I2V 14B 720P
summary: Image-to-video at 720p — animates a still image into a higher-resolution video. Same architecture as 480P variant but supports larger output.

name: Wan 2.1 FLF2V 14B 720P
summary: First-last-frame-to-video — provide a start and end image and the model generates the transition video between them. 720p output.

name: Wan 2.2 T2V A14B
summary: Highest-quality text-to-video. Dual-stage architecture uses separate low-noise and high-noise models for superior coherence and detail. Requires ~20 GB VRAM.

name: Wan 2.2 I2V A14B
summary: Highest-quality image-to-video. Dual-stage architecture animates still images with exceptional motion coherence. Requires ~20 GB VRAM.

name: LTX-2.3 22B
summary: High-quality 22B text-to-video model. Q4_K_M is the recommended quant for 24 GB RTX cards or high-memory Apple Silicon. ComfyUI-backed.

name: LTX-2.3 Distilled
summary: PocketAI's native 4-bit MLX release of the distilled LTX-2.3 audio-video pipeline for Apple Silicon. Uses the fast 8+3-step two-stage path with synchronized audio; 16 GB works in low-memory mode and 24 GB is recommended.

name: LTX-2.3 Distilled 8-bit
summary: PocketAI's native 8-bit MLX release of the distilled LTX-2.3 audio-video pipeline for Apple Silicon. Offers higher transformer precision than 4-bit while retaining the fast 8+3-step two-stage path with synchronized audio; 24 GB works in low-memory mode and 32 GB is recommended.

name: LTX-2.3 Distilled BF16
summary: PocketAI's native unquantized BF16 MLX release of the distilled LTX-2.3 audio-video pipeline for high-memory Apple Silicon. Preserves the converted transformer's full BF16 precision and uses the fast 8+3-step two-stage path with synchronized audio; 48 GB works in low-memory mode and 64 GB is recommended.

name: Wan2.2 T2V A14B Q4
summary: PocketAI's recommended Q4 MLX release of Wan2.2 T2V A14B for Apple Silicon. The precision-specific snapshot includes dual high/low-noise experts, shared T5/VAE support models, and the corrected offline runtime. Listed for discovery until PocketAI's native Wan MLX runner ships.

name: Wan2.2 T2V A14B Q8
summary: PocketAI's higher-detail Q8 MLX release of Wan2.2 T2V A14B for large-memory Apple Silicon Macs. The precision-specific snapshot includes dual high/low-noise experts, shared T5/VAE support models, and the corrected offline runtime. Listed for discovery until PocketAI's native Wan MLX runner ships.

name: Wan2.2 T2V A14B BF16
summary: PocketAI's unquantized BF16 MLX release of Wan2.2 T2V A14B for high-memory Apple Silicon Macs. The precision-specific snapshot includes dual high/low-noise experts, shared T5/VAE support models, and the corrected offline runtime. Listed as an experimental maximum-precision option until PocketAI's native Wan MLX runner ships.

name: HunyuanVideo 1.5 Q4
summary: PocketAI's lower-memory Q4 revision of the consolidated HunyuanVideo 1.5 MLX repository for Apple Silicon. The transformer uses Q4 group-64 with sensitive BF16 paths, the Qwen text tower uses Q4, and the VAE remains BF16. Territory excludes the EU, UK, and South Korea. Listed for discovery until PocketAI's native Hunyuan MLX runner ships.

name: HunyuanVideo 1.5 BF16
summary: PocketAI's full-fidelity BF16 revision of the consolidated HunyuanVideo 1.5 MLX repository for high-memory Apple Silicon Macs. The transformer, Qwen text tower, and VAE are BF16. Territory excludes the EU, UK, and South Korea. Listed for discovery until PocketAI's native Hunyuan MLX runner ships.

name: Kandinsky 5 T2V Lite Distilled 5s
summary: Lightweight 2B text-to-video model distilled to 16 steps for faster 5-second clips. ComfyUI-backed and currently CUDA-only in PocketAI.

name: Kandinsky 5 T2V Pro SFT 5s
summary: Flagship 19B Kandinsky 5 text-to-video model for high-quality 5-second clips from English or Russian prompts with controllable camera motion. Requires a high-memory NVIDIA workstation.

name: Kandinsky 5 T2V Pro SFT 10s
summary: Flagship 19B Kandinsky 5 text-to-video model for high-quality 10-second clips from English or Russian prompts with controllable camera motion. Uses NABLA sparse attention and requires a high-memory NVIDIA workstation.

name: MiniMax H3 FL2VA ConvRot INT8
summary: MiniMax H3 FL2VA for text-to-video with native synchronized 32 kHz stereo audio and optional first and last frames. PocketAI uses Comfy-Org's pruned INT8 transformer and NVFP4/AWQ Qwen3-VL-32B encoder (42.47 GB across all required files). Windows uses NVIDIA CUDA with system-RAM offload. Apple Silicon uses PocketAI's experimental native MLX text-to-video backend, with 64 GB unified memory required and 96 GB or more recommended; first/last-frame conditioning is currently available through the CUDA backend only. The MiniMax H3 Community License excludes the EU, UK, South Korea, and United States; products must display "MiniMax H3", and annual product or service revenue above USD $20M requires separate authorization.

name: MiniMax H3 MLX Q4
summary: Mac-native MiniMax H3 FL2VA with a standard MLX Q4 transformer, 8-bit AdaLN projections cached and released at startup, and PocketAI's shared NVFP4/AWQ Qwen3-VL-32B text encoder. This is the smallest H3 MLX option; Q6 is recommended when memory allows. Text-to-video includes synchronized 32 kHz stereo audio. The MiniMax H3 Community License excludes the EU, UK, South Korea, and United States.

name: MiniMax H3 MLX Q6
summary: Mac-native MiniMax H3 FL2VA with a standard MLX Q6 transformer, 8-bit AdaLN projections cached and released at startup, and PocketAI's shared NVFP4/AWQ Qwen3-VL-32B text encoder. Q6 is the recommended balance of visual fidelity and memory use. Text-to-video includes synchronized 32 kHz stereo audio. The MiniMax H3 Community License excludes the EU, UK, South Korea, and United States.

name: MiniMax H3 MLX Q8
summary: Mac-native MiniMax H3 FL2VA with a standard MLX Q8 transformer, 8-bit AdaLN projections cached and released at startup, and PocketAI's shared NVFP4/AWQ Qwen3-VL-32B text encoder. Q8 preserves more transformer detail at a higher memory and disk cost. Text-to-video includes synchronized 32 kHz stereo audio. The MiniMax H3 Community License excludes the EU, UK, South Korea, and United States.

name: MiniMax H3 MLX BF16
summary: Mac-native MiniMax H3 FL2VA with the transformer in BF16 and PocketAI's shared NVFP4/AWQ Qwen3-VL-32B text encoder. AdaLN projections are cached and released at startup, but this remains the largest and highest-fidelity MLX option and is intended for high-memory Macs. Text-to-video includes synchronized 32 kHz stereo audio. The MiniMax H3 Community License excludes the EU, UK, South Korea, and United States.

name: Wan Dancer 14B
summary: Hierarchical music-to-dance model using paired global and local Wan 14B diffusion weights. Listed for discovery until PocketAI gains audio-conditioned Wan Dancer generation and its required distillation-LoRA workflow.
